# authwise_issuer (Data Source)

An OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect issuer: the login a set of clients shares, with its domain, token lifetimes and which realm or realms people sign in to (`config`). This data source reads one by its full resource name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full resource name of the object to read.

### Read-Only

- `appearance_profile_id` (String)
- `config` (String)
- `domain_name` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `path` (String)
- `tenant_id` (String)
